purpose: Validate whether the mathematical multiresolution construction faithfully carries the user's financial hypothesis before any new A/B economic test.

objects.S0: causal low-point skeleton from confirmed base waves
objects.S1: causal low-point skeleton extracted from S0 using the same graphical wave principle
objects.S2: causal low-point skeleton extracted from S1

period_rule.T0: measured from actual confirmed base waves
period_rule.T1: measured from actual confirmed S0 waves
period_rule.T2: measured from actual confirmed S1 waves
period_rule.test: report empirical T1/T0 and T2/T0 distributions before any outcome analysis

primary_fidelity_questions: Can C1 and C2 be causally constructed at base-level decision times with nontrivial coverage?
Do identified adjacent levels have stable period-ratio distributions without outcome-conditioned tuning?
Do full K-line visual examples support that each recursive layer is a genuine coarser graphical wave rather than a bookkeeping artifact?
Can absent, unconfirmed, stale and weak components be distinguished rather than collapsed together?

B_structural_hypothesis_after_fidelity.whipsaw_regime: C1 strong/adverse or near its own turn while C2 is weak/unresolved
B_structural_hypothesis_after_fidelity.persistence_regime: C1 weak while C2 is strong, directionally aligned and not near its own turn

A_structural_hypothesis_after_fidelity.parent: the same first-lower-frequency graphical wave used by the decomposition
A_structural_hypothesis_after_fidelity.target: new future parent phase change/turn after child confirmation
